text:
sam: Heads-up — console is showing a weird quota burn spike for a handful of tenants, but backend logs show no extra traffic. Can we sync?

maya: Saw this too on staging. Looks like duplicate attributions from telemetry pipeline?

ryan: Quick hypothesis: SDK retries + edge proxy retry + console ingestion are all counting tokens independently. We had a caching dedupe before but it was scoped to request-id header only.

akiko: Is anyone seeing repeated route headers in the raw events? I pulled a sample: 
```
Headers: {
  "x-request-id": "req_abc123",
  "x-route-hint": "tenant=acme;quota=high",
  "x-route-hint": "tenant=acme;quota=high"
}
```
If the publisher doesn't collapse duplicates, the console sees two attributions.

sam: That matches. I also found a pattern where python-sdk retries were attaching an internal metadata header twice on retry, because the retry wrapper re-initializes headers and appends instead of replacing.

jen: Which header exactly? We should patch rather than rely on console dedupe.

sam: It's `x-route-hint` in py-sdk v0.14.2. The logic does `headers.setdefault('x-route-hint', [])` then extend.

maya: Oof. TS and Go look fine on quick scan, but Go has an odd path where proxies merge incoming and upstream headers and can duplicate if upstream also sent it.

ryan: So we have two failure modes: client-side duplicates + proxy merge duplicates. Both inflate quota signals. We should fix client first (fast) and then put defensive dedupe in ingestion (slow).

akiko: Agreed. Proposed plan: 
1) Patch py-sdk to replace header on retry (bugfix) and release patch.
2) Add a quick ingestion dedupe keyed by (request_id, header_normalized) in console pipeline for the next 24h to stop immediate noise.
3) Add a telemetry test that generates retry flows and ensures only 1 attribution.

jen: For the patch, can we do a micro-release today? We have approvals for emergency py patches.

sam: I can PR in ~2 hours. Minimal change: in retry wrapper do `headers['x-route-hint'] = new_value` instead of append.

maya: For ingestion dedupe — small stateful window (5s) should be enough. ops-bot, can you kick a short-lived job that inserts a dedupe stage in staging?

ops-bot: @maya created a temporary dedupe lambda for the staging pipeline with 5s window. Monitoring alerts will be quieted for staged tenants.

ryan: Also add a normalization step for header casing and whitespace; we saw `tenant=acme` vs `Tenant=acme ` causing distinct keys. Small function: `normalize_route_hint(s) -> s.strip().lower()` before hashing.

akiko: Console UX note — when dedupe is active, show a small badge: "Attribution dedupe active" in the quota chart to avoid confusion during the mitigation window. Can product approve? @jen

jen: Product 👍 on the badge. Also want event in audit log whenever dedupe kicks in so customers can see why counts changed.

sam: One more: during rollout, keep canaries with clients that use older SDKs to ensure no subtle regressions. We'll push py patch to canary hosts first then global.

maya: Timeline idea: patch PR now, canary release in 4h, ingestion dedupe in 1h for staging, prod ingestion dedupe scheduled after 2h review, console badge + audit log after dedupe deployed.

ryan: I'll own unit & integration tests for the ingestion pipeline change. Will add a test harness that replays a retry trace and checks single attribution.

sam: I'll open the SDK PR and link here when ready. If we find TS or Go dup later we'll do backports.

akiko: Thanks team. Please add any quick reproducer snippets in the PR so QA can stress test.

sam: PR: https://git.redwood/sam/py-sdk/pull/412 — contains the header replacement fix and test.

maya: Verified the PR on staging canary, metrics look stable for the tenant sample (no spike).

jen: Sounds good. After prod dedupe goes in we'll monitor for 48h and then revert the temporary dedupe stage if stable.

ops-bot: Prod dedupe stage scheduled in 35m for a 1h smoke window. Alerting paused for affected tenants per request.

ryan: Thanks all — keeping this thread pinned until postmortem/retro.

akiko: Adding a short retro doc once we finish: root cause = SDK append bug + header merge behavior. Action items assigned in PR description.

sam: Closing loop: will post follow-up with exact SDK versions and release notes after canary. :white_check_mark:
